prompt:
GAME ITEM SPRITE. One single object seen from above at a slight angle, centred, like an item lying on the ground in a top-down strategy game.

Create an ORIGINAL game item sprite for a vehicle's crew water tank. Images 1 and 2 are our approved camp gear from the same family: match their outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy their shapes.

Draw ONLY the object, alone on a plain pure white background, filling about 80 percent of the canvas. Square canvas.

A flat rectangular black polyethylene water tank of the kind bolted under a four-wheel-drive's tray, with a round blue screw filler cap on top, a small brass tap at one end, two steel mounting straps across it and a short coil of clear hose lying beside it.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, muted canvas and steel colours, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, people, animals, vehicles or ground. No shadow outside the object.
